intro.title: Manage depots
intro.message: A depot is a shop or outlet you sell to. In this practice you'll register one, then find it and see what you can do with it. Nothing you enter is saved.

open.title: Open Depots
open.message: Tap Depots on the Home screen.

add.title: Register a depot
add.message: This is your depot list. Tap + to register a new depot.

identity.title: Who is the depot?
identity.message: Pick the grouping and title, then enter the depot's name in English and in Khmer — both are required. Tap Next Step when you're done.

address.title: Where is it?
address.message: Choose the city, district and commune, and enter the 5–6 digit postal code. Capture the GPS location while standing at the shop — it must be inside Cambodia.

contact.title: How to reach them
contact.message: Enter the mobile phone, the telephone (or tick that it's the same as the mobile), and the contact person's name and role.

sales_terms.title: Sales terms
sales_terms.message: These set how SAP sells to the depot: sales org, office, group, channel, division, depot group, delivery priority, shipping, payment term and tax class. VAT-registered depots also need a VAT TIN.

documents.title: Photos and documents
documents.message: Take photos of the outlet front, the outlet inside and the owner's ID card. VAT-registered depots also need the VAT certificate.

submit.title: Review and submit
submit.message: Check every section, then tap Send to Headquarters. In real use HQ approves it; in practice it isn't sent anywhere.

find.title: Find your depot
find.message: Your new depot is in the list. Tap it to open its details.

manage.title: Manage the depot
manage.message: From here you can call the owner, open it in Maps, add photos, and see its sales and promotions.

done.title: Lesson complete 🎉
done.message: You can now register and manage depots. The practice data has been cleared.

depots.submit_failed: The depot wasn't submitted. Read the message, fix what it names, and tap Send to Headquarters again.

review.title: Review the quotation

submit.title: Send for approval

s1.title: The application
s1.b1: SteelForce is the field sales app for ISI Steel, a member of ISI Group, Phnom Penh, Cambodia. It brings a sales representative's daily work together in one simple app that keeps working even without an internet connection.

s1.title: Information we collect
s1.b1: Your account details, including name, phone number and assigned territory.
s1.b2: Your device location, collected only while you are checking in or out of a customer visit.
s1.b3: Business records you create: visits, stock counts, quotations and orders.
s1.b4: Basic device information used to keep your session secure.

s2.title: How we use information
s2.b1: To show you your route, customers and daily work.
s2.b2: To verify that a visit took place at the customer's location.
s2.b3: To process quotations and orders through the approval and ordering system.
s2.b4: To protect your account against unauthorised access.

s3.title: Data storage and protection
s3.b1: Business data is stored in an encrypted database on your device, so it stays protected even if the device is lost.
s3.b2: Sign-in credentials are held in the device's secure hardware store, never in ordinary application storage.
s3.b3: Data sent to our servers travels over an encrypted connection.

s4.title: Information sharing
s4.b1: Your information is used inside ISI Steel and ISI Group for business operations. It is not sold, and it is not shared with third parties except where required to operate the service or by law.

s5.title: Your rights
s5.b1: You may ask to see the personal information held about you, ask for corrections, or ask questions about how it is used. Contact your manager or the IT team to make a request.

s6.title: Data retention
s6.b1: Business records are kept for as long as company policy and Cambodian law require. Location records are kept only as evidence of completed visits.

s1.title: Protect your account
s1.b1: Never share your password or verification codes with anyone, including colleagues and IT staff.
s1.b2: Use a password you do not use for any other service.
s1.b3: Change your password immediately if you think someone else knows it.

s2.title: Protect your device
s2.b1: Lock your device with a PIN, pattern or biometric when you are not using it.
s2.b2: Keep the application and your device software up to date.
s2.b3: Avoid signing in over public or unsecured wireless networks.
s2.b4: Sign out when using a shared device.

s3.title: Report a problem
s3.b1: If you notice activity you do not recognise, or you lose your device, tell your manager and the IT team straight away. Acting quickly limits what an attacker can reach.

s1.title: Acceptance
s1.b1: By using the SteelForce application you agree to these terms and to the policies of ISI Steel and ISI Group.

s2.title: Permitted use
s2.b1: The application is provided for the business of ISI Steel and may be used only by authorised employees and representatives, for company work.

s3.title: Your responsibilities
s3.b2: Enter accurate customer, visit and order information.
s3.b3: Use customer data only for legitimate business purposes.

s4.title: Company data
s4.b1: All customer, pricing and order information in the application is confidential company property and must not be copied, shared or kept after your employment ends.

s5.title: Availability
s5.b1: The application works offline, but features that need a connection — approvals, synchronisation and live stock — depend on network and server availability.

s1.title: Contact support
s1.b1: Reach the ISI Steel IT support team during business hours for help with sign-in, synchronisation or data questions.

s2.title: Report a problem
s2.b1: Describe what you were doing, what you expected, and what happened instead. Note the date, time and customer if it relates to a visit or order.

s3.title: Common questions
s3.b1: Work saved while offline syncs automatically once you have a connection — you do not need to re-enter it.
s3.b2: If a visit will not check in, confirm that location permission is granted and that you are at the customer's site.
s3.b3: If prices or stock look out of date, allow the application to synchronise while connected.
